anchorAudit.rationale: The museum has four fluted columns below a horizontal entablature, with no triangular pediment. Its entrance, exhibit window and fittings have separate points. The rider beside the bus stop and the parked foreground bicycle are distinct, as are the near and far curbs. Obscured hardware and unsupported architectural terms remain searchable in the index. Human review of the revised points is pending.
